meta.title: Hoi An Lantern Festival – Should You Go on Full Moon Night?
meta.description:
Should you go to the Hoi An Lantern Festival on full moon night?
It depends on the kind of experience you're looking for.
The Hoi An Lantern Festival is one of the most beautiful and iconic experiences in Vietnam. Every month, on the 14th day of the lunar calendar, lanterns illuminate the ancient town while parts of the public street lighting are dimmed, creating the warm atmosphere that has made Hoi An famous around the world.
But full-moon night is also the busiest time to visit.
In this video, Discover Da Nang shows you what the Hoi An Lantern Festival is really like during peak hours. We explore the busiest areas of the Ancient Town, including the Night Market, the Japanese Covered Bridge, and the Hoai River, where visitors line up for boat rides and floating lantern experiences.
Rather than simply recommending the festival, this video presents both sides of the experience. You'll see the beauty of thousands of glowing lanterns, but also the reality of large crowds, busy streets, and long queues that many first-time visitors don't expect.
You'll also learn practical tips before visiting, including:
• The best time to experience Hoi An at night
• Where the largest crowds usually gather
• What to expect from boat rides on the Hoai River
• How boat prices are typically arranged
• Tips for avoiding confusion before boarding
• A more environmentally responsible way to enjoy Hoi An's famous floating lantern tradition
If you prefer a quieter atmosphere, we also share some of the best alternatives - including weekday evenings, arriving before the peak crowds, staying later after most visitors leave, and exploring the peaceful streets just beyond the busiest tourist areas.
Whether you're planning your first trip to Hoi An or deciding if full-moon night is right for you, this video offers an honest, balanced look at one of Vietnam's most photographed destinations.
If you enjoy authentic travel guides with practical local advice, subscribe to Discover Da Nang for more videos about Da Nang, Hoi An, and Central Vietnam.
